sections.title: Acknowledgment
sections.html: I acknowledge that I have received, read, and understand the Health, Safety & Security policies contained in Chapter 06 of the Employee Handbook, Revision 4.0. I understand that I am required to comply with the MH Construction MISH Program and any applicable Site Specific Safety Plan (SSSP) for my assigned project. I understand that I have both the authority and the obligation to stop work when a condition is unsafe.
